entities.summary: Eleanor Irene Clift is an American political journalist, television pundit, and author. She is a contributor to MSNBC and blogger for The Daily Beast. She is best known as a regular panelist on The McLaughlin Group. Clift is a board member at the IWMF. Eleanor Clift was a authors & novelists from Brooklyn (b. 1940-07-07, Brooklyn). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
